mapper.sql: id, order_id, user_id, amount, reason, kind, status, prev_status, applied_at, reviewed_at, reviewer_id, review_remark, return_tracking_no, return_shipped_at, received_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_refund (order_id, user_id, amount, reason, kind, status, prev_status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{prevStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE order_refund SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewed_at = NOW(3), reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE order_refund SET status = 'RETURNING', reviewed_at = NOW(3), reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND kind = 'RETURN'
UPDATE order_refund SET status = 'RETURN_SHIPPED', return_tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, return_shipped_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'RETURNING' AND kind = 'RETURN'
UPDATE order_refund SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_at = NOW(3), reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE order_refund SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', reviewed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
